capabilities: Map a vault file to a named CSS custom property
Resolve file paths to loadable resource URLs on every app load
Follow renamed or moved files automatically
Add and remove mappings from a settings file picker
disambiguation: Not a styling tool or general CSS variables editor; it only maps vault files to url() values and lets themes decide what to do with them.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README states no network calls or telemetry, and that duplicate variable names warn but are not blocked.
motivation: The README frames the missing piece for theme and snippet authors who want users to plug in their own local image, font, or other asset.
problem: Theme and snippet CSS runs without a folder context, so relative paths to local files cannot resolve and only the plugin API can produce a loadable resource URL.
summary: Vault-file-to-CSS-variable mapper that exposes local images or fonts to themes and snippets as var() url() values.
